requested_scene:
Create a NEW Akari v3.1 slice-of-life illustration. PORTRAIT 2:3 composition, a clear upright KNEELING action beside a low wooden bookshelf.

Akari is tidying a small stack of books. She kneels on both knees on a cream rug in front of the low shelf, with her torso upright and her hips lifted a little above her heels so she can reach the middle shelf. Both shins extend behind her along the rug; the relaxed grey-socked feet lie behind the bent knees, naturally visible from the side. Show the folded lower-leg geometry clearly and keep the figure's weight supported by her knees. Do not use a floor-seated pose with legs extended forward.
One hand is sliding the last thin paperback vertically into the low shelf. Her other forearm supports two small books comfortably against her torso. She has turned her head toward the nearby viewer during the task, with a gentle, slightly amused closed-mouth smile, as if answering while finishing the shelf. The lifted arm, shoulder turn and kneeling hips should make the mid-task moment feel spontaneous.

Use a front-side three-quarter view at about her kneeling eye height, a little wider to include her full head, hands, both knees, shins and socked feet. The bookshelf occupies one side of the frame. The face, book-placing hand and upright body are the narrative focus. The plaid skirt follows the folded kneeling legs naturally. Soft knit folds appear at the bent ankles; let ordinary overlap between the feet and legs remain physically believable rather than forcing them toward the viewer.
Warm daylight from an off-frame window, a small plant above the shelf, a plain basket below, one closed book waiting on the rug. A small glimpse of the sofa farther back can connect the home setting, but the bookshelf and kneeling action define this composition. Clear book edges and connected fingers; no readable titles needed.
output_transformation: Byte-for-byte copy of generated PNG; no compositing or pixel editing.

visual_review.pose: Clear upright kneeling position supported by two knees, with both lower legs folded behind along the rug.
visual_review.expression_and_action: The book-placing hand, books supported at the torso and head turn form a coherent mid-task moment. Face, bob and silver pin remain consistent.
visual_review.materials: Grey rib-knit socks retain soft rounded toe ends, with stronger natural folds at the bent ankles.
visual_review.limitations: Reaching sleeve is pushed back to the forearm. Book-spine markings are decorative rather than meaningful readable text.
visual_review.method: Original-resolution saved PNG compared with the viewed P1/P2/U1/L1/F01 inputs and F02 material example.
visual_review.selection_status_at_review: Candidate at the time of assistant review; subsequently selected by the user.
